entries.title: Start Secrets over when it can no longer read what it kept
entries.body: If Infinitary can no longer read the secrets and saved decisions kept on this computer, such as after its data folder was removed, Settings → Secrets now offers Start over beside Recovery options, so you are no longer stuck without a backup. After your computer confirms it is you, Secrets starts again with an empty list: stored secrets, saved decisions, phone approvals and temporary access are cleared for good, and history is kept.

picture.alt: Settings → Secrets marked Permissions need recovery, with a notice that Infinitary can no longer read what this computer keeps, Recovery options and Start over beside it, and a line saying what Start over clears and that it cannot be undone
